module_summary: Sequential 8x8 shift-add multiplier with optional signed mode: start handshake latches operands, a busy flag and 4-bit counter iterate add/shift over a 16-bit product register, then a held done signal awaits acknowledge.

anchors.name: n17_73a
anchors.why: Two-state busy flag: set on accepted start, cleared at final iteration; gates all datapath updates

anchors.name: n12_b52
anchors.why: 16-bit product/multiplier shift register accumulating partial sums each iteration

anchors.name: n20_389
anchors.why: Start request input; when idle and not done, latches operands and begins multiplication

anchors.name: n18_115
anchors.why: Result-valid output set at last iteration, held until acknowledged; blocks new starts

anchors.name: n16_fac
anchors.why: 16-bit product output, sign-corrected halves of product register

anchors.name: n0_70f
anchors.why: 8-bit multiplier operand, absolute value loaded into product register

anchors.name: n2_beb
anchors.why: 8-bit multiplicand operand, converted to 9-bit addend register

anchors.name: n6_b16
anchors.why: Acknowledge input clearing the held result-valid output

anchors.name: n25_17f
anchors.why: Signed-mode select controlling operand negation and output sign correction

anchors.name: n3_a62
anchors.why: Iteration counter; bit 3 ends multiplication and sets result-valid

anchors.name: n9_ede
anchors.why: 9-bit multiplicand addend latched at start, added each iteration

anchors.name: n1_b7a
anchors.why: Add-or-pass partial sum selected by adder carry, shifted into product register

anchors.name: n8_f0b
anchors.why: Latched operand copy whose sign bits drive output sign correction

groups.name: sequencing control
groups.description: Busy flag, iteration counter and held done flag with acknowledge

groups.name: shift-add datapath
groups.description: Product register, addend register and conditional adder per iteration

groups.name: sign handling
groups.description: Latched operand signs and two's-complement correction of product halves
